title: Revision loading procedures
description: Store immutable LoadingProcedureRevision records for a printing setup, covering feed source, leading edge, and printable-face direction while preserving referenced history.
acceptanceCriteria: Each loading revision references one setup and contains validated feed source, leading edge, and printable-face direction
Editing creates a new revision with stable lineage instead of mutating the prior revision
Previously referenced revisions remain readable and byte/logically unchanged after editing
Revision history survives reload and unknown values remain explicit

steps.details: Add a versioned immutable LoadingProcedureRevision with setup ID, revision ID/number, predecessor, three explicit assumption fields, provenance, and timestamps.
Add repository operations that create an initial revision and append validated successors without update-in-place behavior.
Add an accessible edit-as-new-revision action that shows current assumptions and preserves unknown states without coercive defaults.
Verify initial creation, successor creation, prior-reference stability, invalid input refusal, and reload through focused unit and browser tests.

technicalNotes: Maximum execution scope is ten minutes; extend the established immutable-revision and repository patterns only.
Do not encode a judgment that any loading procedure is suitable or mechanically safe.
The operator, not the browser, owns loading orientation and feed-source accuracy.
